questions.text: A 32 × 32 RGB image is split into non-overlapping 8 × 8 patches, then one [CLS] token is added. How many tokens enter the encoder?
questions.explanation: There are (32/8)*(32/8)=16 patches, plus one [CLS] token, giving17 tokens.
